nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template documenting every runtime environment variable for AdaptED: app metadata, CORS and JWT token settings, the PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, OpenRouter chat/embedding credentials and models, EMBEDDING_DIM=2048, and SearxNG search options. Copied to the git-ignored .env that pydantic-settings reads at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Env-file convention: the real .env holds live credentials (OpenRouter API key, DB password) and is never committed; this example mirrors its keys with safe placeholders.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Intentionally empty placeholder readme; the project's real conventions and running history are kept in AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md instead.

nodes.name: opencode.json
nodes.summary: Configuration for the opencode CLI coding agent in this repository, using the instructions array to auto-load AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md as instruction context for every session.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: uv/hatchling package manifest for adapted v0.1.0 declaring the FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + pgvector + Streamlit + OpenAI/LangGraph dependency stack, dev tooling (pytest with asyncio auto mode, ruff at line-length 100 / py312), and wheel packaging of the src/adapted layout.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 735 [dependency-groups] for dev deps and hatchling as the build backend targeting the src layout (packages = ["src/adapted"]).
